hints.title: Candidate Uniform Targets
hints.text: All elements can either be transformed to positive one or to negative one.

hints.title: Count Inversions
hints.text: Tally how many elements differ from the chosen target value.

hints.title: Threshold Comparison
hints.text: Check if the minimum of the two inversion counts is less than or equal to k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def canTransform(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> bool:
        count_pos = sum(1 for x in nums if x == 1)
        count_neg = sum(1 for x in nums if x == -1)
        # Min flips to make all 1 is count_neg, to make all -1 is count_pos
        return min(count_pos, count_neg) <= k
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all combination sequences of flip operations is needlessly complex.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct frequency counting uses two integer accumulators.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that there are only two valid end states for parity.
